description:
[read-only] Running, planned and recently finished campaigns (organic, paid or mixed), each with dates, status, posts published of planned, reach, impressions, engagements, link clicks, and for paid spend and cost per result, the goal with its success measure (`success`), plus a daily impressions trend. `aggregate` is all listed campaigns together, with a daily series. Posts in no campaign roll up under `notInCampaign`. A null measure means not reported by any network, never zero.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaigns/analytics.)

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

includeUnassigned.description: Include the "Not in a campaign" roll-up (default true).

name: list_campaign_analytics
title: List campaigns with their numbers
